settings.label: New agent
settings.help: The key that opens the notch of a new agent: "right-command" (the default), "right-option", "right-shift", "right-control" or "left-command" and the other left keys for a tap of the key alone, a shortcut such as "ctrl+option+k" or "f13", or "off". A key that types needs a modifier. The front app gets the shortcut too.
settings.words: key keys shortcut hotkey keyboard custom record notch

settings.label: Voice note
settings.help: The key of the voice note: the same names as newAgentKey. "off" is the default. With the window of Yonder in front, it opens the talk bar of the agent, and a second tap sends.
settings.words: key keys shortcut hotkey keyboard custom record dictate dictation

settings.label: New chat
settings.words: key keys shortcut hotkey keyboard new chat agent menu
settings.help: A shortcut in the window, such as "cmd+t", "shift+cmd+r" or "f13", or "off". The names are those of newAgentKey, with no modifier key alone.
